flagship.name: Open or Sealed
flagship.question: Should you open it, or keep it sealed?
lines: Pull rates and singles prices give the expected value of what's inside.
The sealed price is the clean one: flagged sales are taken out first.
Two odds from the Monte Carlo: a hit worth $50 or more, and one worth $200 or more.
The verdict is about a box you already hold. It is never a reason to buy one.
flagship.check: Every verdict is dated and checked 30 days later, in public.

shows.name: Open or Sealed
shows.line: One product, the math rendered, a dated verdict: OPEN, KEEP or DEPENDS.

shows.name: Market Radar
shows.line: What's moving, with the fake sales taken out. Movers, flags and the week's file.

shows.name: The Sell Side
shows.line: Shows, shipping, what sold and for what, what didn't.

shows.name: Open or Sealed Live
shows.line: Chat votes, the math on screen, then the box opens. From the rip list only.

shows.name: The File
shows.line: One card or product as an artifact: every sale it ever had, the story around it, rendered.

partners.lead: Two units, free, with a link back: the weekly Open or Sealed verdict card and the Flag Report card, as images at stable URLs, plus the JSON behind them for anyone who wants to render it themselves.
partners.note: Verdicts are dated and checked 30 days later in public. Flags name the reason a sale was kept out of the math. Nothing recommends a purchase.
